commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 37 and the deterministic gate locked in WEAK, disciplined practitioners must respect general market direction above individual charts. The sharp 350-point Nifty index advance represents concentrated short-covering in mega-cap IT rather than broad institutional accumulation. In accordance with Stan Weinstein's Stage discipline and William O'Neil's market timing rules, swing exposure must remain defensive. While selective Stage 2 candidates show constructive relative strength, cash is a valid tactical position. Apply Minervini's progressive exposure rule: initiate minimal pilot positions only upon confirmed pivot breakouts, insist on strict stop discipline, and demand accelerating quarterly earnings before committing fresh risk capital.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

21STCENMGM.technical: Price cleared a 20-session pivot at 46.54 backed by 3.89x volume expansion, positioning above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA with positive MACD. However, long-term moving averages reflect choppy basing rather than a high-conviction Stage 2 trend, and relative strength remains erratic against broader indices.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Capital market investment firm with extreme earnings volatility. Despite a Q1 FY27 bounce to ₹9 Cr PAT, prior quarters recorded losses. Operating metrics swing wildly with zero operational predictability, negating CANSLIM institutional sponsorship standards despite minimal debt.
21STCENMGM.risk: A breakdown below 43.53 invalidates the breakout pivot. Cut losses instantly given erratic fundamentals and low liquidity.

ADVANCE.technical: Post-listing Stage 2 run confirmed by a decisive 20-day high breakout at 141.64 on massive 11.4x volume. Price sits comfortably above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. Daily RSI at 70 confirms powerful upside momentum without excessive extension.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Agrochemical technical and formulation manufacturer demonstrating explosive CANSLIM metrics. Latest sales surged 96% YoY with net profit jumping 152%. Strong 3-year average ROE of 24%, ROCE near 20%, manageable leverage (D/E 0.71), and 69.9% unpledged promoter holding.
ADVANCE.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 128.51 pivot support. Exit immediately to prevent false breakout whipsaws.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook Stage 2 intermediate consolidation, carving out a double-bottom structure with a neckline trigger at 1530.23. The stock successfully tested the rising 21-EMA on strong demand and holds firmly above ascending 50-day and 200-day averages, showing dominant relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: High-quality market leader in liquid and LPG terminal infrastructure. Q1 net profit rose 212% driven by robust terminalling throughput and Vopak joint-venture expansions. Healthy ROCE (13.3%), strong institutional backing (FII 19.5%), and 58.1% unpledged promoter holding confirm institutional accumulation.
AEGISLOG.risk: Thesis fails on a close below 1383.96 swing support. Enforce strict stop discipline to protect capital.

AEROENTER.technical: Developing double-bottom formation attempting to clear the 159.76 neckline pivot. Price trades above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with volume running at 5.55x the 20-day average. RSI at 65 confirms accumulation, though overhead supply near 160 remains restrictive.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Headline net profit expanded 617% in Q1 FY27, but earnings quality is heavily distorted by ₹144 Cr in exceptional other income. Core operating profit margin compressed to 9%. While virtually debt-free (D/E 0.04), mediocre 3-year ROE (9.2%) requires caution.
AEROENTER.risk: Violation of the 146.68 swing low invalidates pattern construction. Exit decisively if support gives way.

AEROFLEX.technical: Potent Stage 2 leader consolidating within 1.5% of its 584.73 multi-week pivot on a 9.3x volume surge. Moving averages are in classic SEPA alignment (Price > EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200) with an RSI of 63 signaling orderly accumulation.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Manufacturer of stainless steel flexible hoses displaying premier CANSLIM growth attributes. Net profit surged 162% YoY on 76% sales growth in Q1 FY27. Strong operational efficiency with 18.9% ROCE, virtually debt-free balance sheet (D/E 0.02), and 65.5% promoter ownership.
AEROFLEX.risk: A breakdown below the 522.61 consolidation pivot voids the setup. Cut losses promptly to respect stop limits.

AETHER.technical: Constructive double-bottom base building below the 1815.91 neckline trigger. Moving averages exhibit positive slope above the rising 30-week line, and an RSI of 64 confirms accumulation without being extended from intermediate support.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemical producer demonstrating sustained C+A earnings qualification. Net profit rose 33% YoY on 29% revenue growth in Q1 FY27 following Site 5 expansion. Prudent balance sheet with low debt (D/E 0.19), 74.9% promoter holding, and solid institutional interest.
AETHER.risk: Thesis is invalidated if price drops below 1676.19 base support. Adhere to Minervini risk-containment discipline.
